follow-up time: From birth to postnatal period (duration not specified)
outcome: Incidence of congenital anomalies (diagnosed by ultrasound and postnatal examination)
cohort: 739 pregnant women who conceived through ICSI and 843 pregnant women who conceived spontaneously
finding: ICSI was associated with a higher incidence of multiple pregnancy and cesarean section, but there was no significant difference in the incidence of congenital anomalies compared to spontaneous conception.
